openings.claim: Replace a single provisional confusion table with an adjudication ledger carrying conservative bounds on candidate-minus-baseline correctness, overall and by slice. Advance only when every remaining label assignment passes; reject only when none passes; otherwise report unresolved.
openings.delta: Change the decision dependency from provisional point counts to unresolved-label bounds, and selection from fixed record order to threshold-sensitive differing-prediction rows. Identical predictions contribute zero regardless of label; an unresolved differing-prediction row conservatively contributes between minus one and plus one. Keep nonflagged supplied labels fixed. Prioritize the slice at minus two and disagreements in the apparent gain slice by which adjudication could change the possible decisions; break ties by record identifier.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, fixed identifier-order adjudication using the same conservative decision rule, threshold-sensitive selection may resolve the decision with fewer adjudications. It should not produce a supported decision inconsistent with the full-label key. A concentration of unresolved influential rows in withheld records may defeat the selection advantage.
openings.probe: Run both workflows on the matched copies with separately reset sixteen-row allowances and the same four preselected withheld rows. Freeze reports before opening the full-label key. Compare decision agreement, unresolved frequency for this pair, adjudications consumed and elapsed time. Log every selected identifier, selection reason, returned label or withheld status, and resulting bounds. Never repeat a withheld request. Stop within sixteen successful adjudications and seventy minutes; unresolved is mandatory if bounds still straddle acceptance. This probe evaluates review decisions, not classifier deployment.
assumptions: Only flagged supplied labels are eligible for correction; unresolved flagged labels remain uncertain.
Actual prediction distribution and analyst execution time are unavailable here; faster resolution is a hypothesis.
Withheld influential rows, conservative bounds or spreadsheet bookkeeping cost can erase the advantage. Reject requires joint infeasibility, not merely one failing provisional count.
No additional records, equipment, threshold changes or adjudication access are required.

assessment: One opening. The supplied gains do not establish advancement because disputed labels can change total and slice counts. The bounded probe can discriminate selection efficiency on the supplied pair; it cannot establish general reliability.
